costa-rica.title: Flag of the Republic of Costa Rica

colors.note: Upper and lower bands; represents the sky, opportunity, and idealism.
Bands between the blue and red; represents peace, wisdom, and happiness.
Central double-wide band; represents warmth, generosity, and the blood shed for liberty.

desc:
- Five horizontal bands of blue, white, red (double width), white, and blue; the state flag bears the coat of arms in a white oval on the red band toward the hoist
- Designed by Pacifica Fernandez, wife of President Jose Maria Castro Madriz, and adopted on 27 November 1848
- The red band was added to the earlier yellow-white-blue arrangement, inspired by the flag of France of the 1848 revolutions
trivia:
- The flag was inspired by the French tricolour after the 1848 revolutions in Europe, reflecting Costa Rica's turn toward republican ideals
- The coat of arms on the state flag depicts three volcanoes, two oceans, and seven stars for the country's provinces
- The civil flag, flown without the coat of arms, is identical in colours and arrangement to that of Thailand
